name: com.lucabiada.streamdiffusion
description: Interactive realtime image generation (StreamDiffusion) controlled from Unity: runtime component and UI, installer, Python server (WebSocket control + shared-memory video + NDI out). Works in the Editor and in an exported Windows build.

samples.description: A scene with animated spheres as the input, a depth-map camera for ControlNet, and the StreamDiffusion panel ready to use.
